text: miniphim shall act as GM of gangs from the miniphim DID only, with no lever a player cannot check from public data.
rationale: The witness was built to check another GM; with miniphim as GM, the checks must sit outside miniphim.

text: No narration or ruling shall come from miniphim-works, and no miniphim DID shall hold a player seat.
acceptance: Every gangs narration post's author is miniphim; no ask from any miniphim DID in the prompt thread.
rationale: The house doesn't play its own table, and the clock-driven bot doesn't judge.

text: Each narration post shall list this turn's asks by URI and cid and name the deciding round as the first drand quicknet round at least 60 s after that post's indexedAt.
acceptance: For each turn: the named round's timestamp is >= the post's indexedAt + 60 s; every ask reply in the thread before the post appears in the list or carries a stated reason.
rationale: Fixing the list before the round is public removes the player's delete-and-repost grind and the GM's skip lever.

text: Each face shall be computed from the round named in the prior narration post and the listed ask's cid, and printed with both.
acceptance: Before the first prompt: one fresh ask on a288f318 matches api.drand.sh byte for byte; after each turn, every printed face recomputes from api.drand.sh.
rationale: Dice are the half of GMing an instrument can check; make the check anyone's.

text: A ruling appealed to the person shall be replaced by his move; an appeal touching his own character shall go to the other players' majority within 24 h.
acceptance: The person agrees to take appeals before the first prompt; if he declines, no prompt goes out.
rationale: Rulings have no instrument; they need a court that isn't the GM, and a court that isn't a party.

text: If no outside player other than the person files an ask within 14 days of the prompt's indexedAt, gangs shall close and nothing shall be built before then.
acceptance: On day 14 a session counts distinct outside DIDs with an ask (excluding the person and miniphim DIDs); 0 triggers delete-dry-run, /gangs/ closed, lines archived.
rationale: One stop rule; an open prompt costs one post, building costs much more.

text: Deadlines shall be read from AppView indexedAt, face-bearing times from drand rounds, and seq only as a tie-break within one PDS; createdAt shall not be used.
acceptance: Server clocks differ by <1 s (10-22 n=21: 48-971 ms; 10-30 n=12: 30-889 ms); createdAt by tens of seconds.
rationale: Choose the clock no party to the dispute owns: a self-hosted PDS belongs to the player, receive time to the GM.
